verdict.rationale: Plausible ships a read-only Stats API covering historical and real-time stats. Its /api/v2/query endpoint accepts simple and complex queries and returns JSON, so an agent can query live data through the API branch of the story. Gaps that hold quality down: the evidence shows no MCP server, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt to make the API easy for agents to discover. Missing for 10: official MCP server, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, hands-on evidence of agents querying the API.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent answer growth questions from live product data by running queries through the API or MCP server

citations.quote: Plausible Stats API is a read-only HTTP interface for viewing historical and real-time stats.
The /api/v2/query endpoint accepts simple and complex stats queries in the POST request body and returns the metrics as JSON.
